summary: 补齐 2026-09-27 中断周更并覆盖至 9 月 29 日：正式纳入 SAVLA、Self-Adaptive VLA、World Action Agent、SafeLoop 四篇正文级深读（均达到新论文深度门槛），补 LIBERO/LIBERO-PRO safety 证据，并完成 discovery、周报、publication 与 source-health 维护；publication refresh 仅保留经主源确认且不破坏历史精度语义的变更。

tracks.name: SAVLA v1 · standard LIBERO Table I
tracks.protocol: Standard LIBERO four-suite evaluation. Paper reports 500 episodes per suite and means over three random seeds; Average is the paper-reported mean across suites.
tracks.trainingRegime: SAVLA and GR00T N1.5 are compared in the reporting paper; external baselines and trainable-head details differ, so this is paper-table evidence rather than a fairness leaderboard.

tracks.name: World Action Agent v1 · LIBERO-PRO six-split aggregate
tracks.tasks: Object / Goal / Spatial × Pos / Task; 10 tasks per split
tracks.protocol: WAA evaluates 60 episodes per split (6 per task); Average is the mean over six split success rates. Reporting paper notes some baseline rollout budgets and system costs differ.
tracks.trainingRegime: WAA evolved skills are learned only from LIBERO-90 and frozen before LIBERO-PRO evaluation; compared systems have heterogeneous models, skills and tool stacks.

tracks.name: SafeLoop v1 · 24-task safety evaluation
tracks.protocol: Safety wrapper evaluation over 24 LIBERO tasks. Success is higher-is-better while Haz-B/Haz-O are lower-is-better; columns are retained together only as a source table and must not be converted to a single rank.
tracks.trainingRegime: Frozen base VLA plus SafeLoop risk predictor and meta safety decider; safety layer is trained separately from the base policy.

results.trainingData: Reporting-paper SAVLA training setup; frozen VLM backbone with SO(3)-equivariant action head and learned canonicalizer.
results.evaluationNotes: Author-reported standard LIBERO suite success rates; 500 episodes per suite, three random seeds. Keep paper-reported Average and do not mix with rotated-camera stress tests.

results.trainingData: GR00T N1.5 baseline as reported in SAVLA Table I; training details are not normalized by VLA-Radar.
results.evaluationNotes: Same reporting table and LIBERO suite columns as SAVLA; retained as cited baseline, not an independent reproduction.

results.trainingData: Multimodal skills evolved from LIBERO-90 sources only and frozen before LIBERO-PRO evaluation; Gemini 3.7 Flash main agent.
results.evaluationNotes: 60 episodes per split / 6 per task for WAA. System includes Contact views, rehearsal, in-view correction and Skill Agent; do not interpret as an end-to-end VLA-only score.

results.trainingData: Baseline configuration as cited/reported by World Action Agent paper.
results.evaluationNotes: Reported baseline; rollout budget/tooling may differ from WAA, so this is source-table context rather than a fairness rank.

results.trainingData: Same WAA harness without the evolved skill library.
results.evaluationNotes: Ablative system-level comparison within WAA; other harness components remain active.

results.trainingData: π0.5 baseline as reported in the WAA paper.
results.evaluationNotes: Reported baseline under the paper's LIBERO-PRO comparison; not a VLA-Radar independent rerun.

results.trainingData: Show-Harness rerun using the same Gemini 3.7 Flash backbone according to the WAA paper.
results.evaluationNotes: The reporting paper notes Show-Harness uses a different rollout count/call budget; kept only as a same-paper context row.

results.trainingData: Frozen base VLA plus separately trained SafeLoop risk predictor and meta safety decider.
results.evaluationNotes: 24 LIBERO tasks, 16 seeds each. Success is higher-better while hazard rates are lower-better; VLA-Radar does not collapse them into one ranking metric.
